subject.title: fix(signal): detect native bot mentions in group gating

question: Should OpenClaw accept stricter Signal native-only `requireMention` behavior for existing groups with configured bot identity but no text mention patterns?
rationale: The patch shape is localized and tested, but it intentionally changes upgrade behavior for an existing group-gating configuration, so automation should not decide the compatibility tradeoff.

options.title: Accept Stricter Native Gating
options.body: Merge with the documented behavior that configured Signal bot identity makes native mention detection enforce `requireMention` and drop unmentioned group messages into bounded pending context.

options.title: Require A Transition Path
options.body: Ask for a compatibility note, migration, or opt-in strict mode before merge if preserving old pass-through behavior matters for existing deployments.

options.title: Pause Native Identity Enforcement
options.body: Do not land this runtime behavior change if configured Signal identity should not make mention detection enforceable yet.

recommendation.title: Accept Stricter Native Gating
recommendation.body: Merge with the documented behavior that configured Signal bot identity makes native mention detection enforce `requireMention` and drop unmentioned group messages into bounded pending context.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent shared mention-policy and Signal gating history makes this the best available owner for the compatibility decision.
